outline:
本課程旨在使學生瞭解科技業各種製造的方法和程序，內容包含:半導體製造、微電子封裝、表面黏著技術裝、印刷電路板PCB製造、液晶面板製程、統計製程管制
This course is intended to provide a comprehensive study of the Modern manufacturing processes .The course is designed principally to provide the following topics:
Semiconductor manufacturing
Electronics packaging
Surface mount technology
PCB manufacturing
Panel manufacturing
Statistical process control
schedule:
w1~3 Semiconductor manufacturing半導體製造
w4~6 Electronics packaging微電子封裝
w7~9 Surface mount technology表面黏著技術
w10~11 PCB manufacturing印刷電路板PCB製造
w12~14 Panel manufacturing液晶面板製程
w15~16 Statistical process control統計製程管制
w 17~18 Term report
assessment:
Attendance 40%
Midterm 30%
Term report 30%
Class participation: extra bonus
